findings.motion: SB 7 passed on third reading (Record 848), 78 yeas, 64 nays
findings.note: Voted nay on House passage of SB 7 (2021 regular session), a bill described in its caption as relating to election integrity and security, with new criminal offenses; the House text includes a section on the form of identification presented.

Filed HB 568 (2025 session) on registering voters at a polling place. As filed, a person could register and vote at the polling place by showing a Texas driver's license or state ID with a current address, or a utility bill together with a license, passport or military photo ID. Referred to the Elections Committee 2025-03-03.
subjects: ID to register at the polling place

findings.note: Filed HB 584 (2025 session) on online voter registration. Applicants with a state driver's license or ID card consent to use of its signature; applicants without one print, sign and submit the application. Referred to the Elections Committee 2025-03-03.
